description: Erection of a single storey modular building to western part of the site within the existing car parking area resulting in the removal of 2no car parking spaces and relocation of the bike rack.
subdivision_of_building: Modular building to be installed in existing car park
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The temporary portacabin hereby permitted shall all be removed from the site by or before 3rd July 2029. The site shall be fully restored to its previous condition by 3rd July 2029, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Council.

The proposal is for temporary use and development. In addition, the Council is not prepared to approve this scheme other than for a limited period, in view of its nature, design and appearance. 

The permanent use and retention of the containers would be unacceptable, contrary to policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

LXA-2483-100-GA Rev P2;
LXA-2483-200-ELE Rev P3.

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The portacabins hereby approved shall be used only for purposes incidental to the use as a school by Moat School and for no other purpose.

In granting this permission, the Council has had regard to the particular circumstances of the case. The use of the portacabins for any other purpose could raise materially different planning considerations and the council wishes to have an opportunity to consider such circumstances at that time, in accordance with Policies T1, DC1, DC4, DC8 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment by EAS Ref:6629-EAS-FRA&SuDS-W-Burlington House School (Rev B, dated March 2026). No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood prevention and mitigation measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details and the development shall be permanently retained in this form and maintained as necessary thereafter. 

To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - Prior to commencement of the development, details of the following external facing materials (including manufacturer's specifications, photographs and/ or a physical sample) shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Council: 

- External walls timber cladding 

The development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the approved details.  The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: Waste is to be collected and stored as per the existing schools site wide strategy
